feature_contract.goal: Restore the driver-seat world camera after every game SceneEffect call without carrying the temporary near-plane effect camera into the next cockpit or player-car draw.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only native driver-seat/SceneEffect view restoration; original input/FFB, HUD, sun/lens/SkyGlow, world particles, DX11 and frozen DXVK remain unmodified.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: The source rebuilds the post-effect camera while ScopedSceneEffect still has positive depth. This vetoes driver-seat eligibility despite gameplay, vehicle and native camera being valid, overwriting the intended seat-relative view.
trace_stages: Native gameplay camera and verified player car choose the selected driver-seat view.
Original Clr_SceneEffect changes the near plane and rebuilds camera matrices for effect drawing.
After original effect submission, world/cockpit view restoration rebuilds a seat-eligible matrix for R84 game draws and OpenXR stereo.
subcomponents: End the SceneEffect depth and semantic scope before restoring the previous camera near plane and recalculating the native world view.
Preserve nested effect suppression, disabled seat/transition fallback, and independently test the actual scope handoff with native C++ smoke.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Nested scene effects do not re-enable the seat prematurely; disabled or transitioning seat keeps original game camera and no FX/HUD scopes leak.

diagnosis.root_cause: The post-SceneEffect CalcCameraMatrix_dest call ran before ScopedSceneEffect destruction, causing DriverSeatRenderPass::IsWorldOrCockpitPass to return false and incorrectly rebuilding an unshifted camera after effect submission.
source_trace: VRDriverSeatCameraEligible gates physical camera displacement on SceneEffectDepth==0.
Clr_SceneEffect_dest temporarily sets near plane to 0.05 and calls the original game effect producer.
Its final CalcCameraMatrix_dest previously ran while the SceneEffect depth still blocked the seat, leaving an unshifted world matrix.
alternatives_rejected: No change to 6DoF pose, per-eye XR WVP, glass alpha or SkyGlow is needed to correct the source-verified view restoration order.
diagnosis.runtime_limit: No headset or live OutRun runtime test performed; visual outcome and frame pacing remain untested.
diagnosis.original_evidence: The old Clr_SceneEffect_dest kept ScopedSceneEffect alive around its final CalcCameraMatrix_dest; IsWorldOrCockpitPass() then returned false, suppressing native driver-seat displacement while restoring the world view.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: The new RunSceneEffectThenRestoreView isolates native near-plane effect matrix work in ScopedSceneEffect and calls final CalcCameraMatrix_dest after depth restoration. The updated native host smoke uses the production helper and asserts seat camera restoration.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: The driver_seat_render_pass_smoke covers nested 2-level effect scopes, camera recompute inside/outside the effect, transition/disabled-seat mono fallback. Exact-SHA x64 host, Win32 R84/R26_SAFE builds and other required gates succeeded; no real HMD claim.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Original Clr_SceneEffect camera is temporary; restored cockpit native view feeds the existing R84 physical left/right stereo paths without changing their compositor contract.

ci_evidence.native_cpp_regression: Updated driver_seat_render_pass_smoke built with the exact x64 host and succeeded in Active Validation
